components.name: Casing joint gasket — suction casing / stage 1
Diffuser — stage 6 (last stage, in the discharge casing when 6 stages)
NDE thrust bearing — paired angular-contact (drum design)
NDE radial bearing — axially free (disc design)

options.label: 3 stages
options.description: 3 impellers in series: suction casing, 2 stage casings and the discharge casing clamped by tie bolts. Total head is roughly 3 x the head per stage.

options.label: 4 stages
options.description: 4 impellers in series: suction casing, 3 stage casings and the discharge casing clamped by tie bolts. Total head is roughly 4 x the head per stage.

options.label: 5 stages
options.description: 5 impellers in series: suction casing, 4 stage casings and the discharge casing clamped by tie bolts. Total head is roughly 5 x the head per stage.

options.label: 6 stages
options.description: 6 impellers in series: suction casing, 5 stage casings and the discharge casing clamped by tie bolts. Total head is roughly 6 x the head per stage.

options.label: Balance drum
options.description: A drum behind the last impeller runs in a close-clearance bush; residual thrust is carried by the NDE thrust bearing (paired angular-contact).

options.label: Balance disc
options.description: A disc with an axial gap to a stationary seat adjusts itself to the thrust; the rotor floats axially and both bearings are radial bearings.

axial.label: Axial section (vertical plane through the shaft axis, front half removed)

horizontal.label: Horizontal section through the shaft axis (upper half removed)

radial.label: Radial section through the stage-2 impeller outlet (seen from the NDE)

xraySets.label: Transparent casings
xraySets.description: Casings, seal chambers, bearing housings, guard and motor frame become transparent.

xraySets.label: See the impellers
xraySets.description: Casings, diffusers, return channels and gaskets transparent: the impellers in series stand out.

xraySets.label: Rotating element only
xraySets.description: Everything except the rotating element is transparent.

overlays.label: Flow path (schematic)
overlays.description: Liquid enters the suction nozzle, passes through every impeller in turn and leaves through the discharge nozzle. Colour shifts from blue to red as pressure rises stage by stage (qualitative). The green trace is the small balance leak-off flow returned to the suction side.
overlays.caveat: Schematic meridional paths for teaching - not a CFD result. Real flow is three-dimensional and swirling.

overlays.label: Axial thrust & balance (schematic)
overlays.description: Each closed impeller has a net axial force toward its suction eye, so with all impellers facing the same way the forces add up toward the suction end. The balance drum (or disc) has discharge pressure on one face and near-suction pressure on the other, giving an opposing force toward the discharge end.
overlays.caveat: Arrow lengths are schematic, not calculated forces.

arrows.label: Sum of impeller axial forces (toward suction)
arrows.description: Pressure on the back shroud exceeds the pressure on the front shroud near the eye, and the incoming flow is turned through 90 degrees; both effects push each impeller toward its suction side.

arrows.label: Balance drum / disc force (toward discharge end)
arrows.description: Discharge pressure acts on the impeller side of the drum or disc; the balance chamber behind it is connected to suction, so the pressure difference across the device pushes the rotor toward the discharge end.

sequences.label: Working principle — impellers in series
sequences.description: How a ring-section multistage pump builds pressure stage by stage. Flow and pressure colours are qualitative.
sequences.caveat: Schematic teaching animation - not a CFD result and not a performance prediction.

steps.label: 1. Liquid enters the suction nozzle
steps.description: Liquid arrives through the suction nozzle at suction pressure. The suction casing turns it into an annular chamber around the shaft and guides it evenly into the eye of the first impeller. Enough suction head (NPSH available) is needed here to avoid cavitation in the first stage.

steps.label: 2. Into the eye of the first-stage impeller
steps.description: The liquid enters the impeller eye axially. The casing wear ring around the eye keeps the leakage from the impeller outlet back to the eye small. The first stage has the lowest pressure in the pump, so it governs NPSH required.

steps.label: 3. The impeller adds energy
steps.description: The rotating vanes turn the flow outward and accelerate it. Energy from the shaft is added to the liquid as a rise in pressure inside the impeller and as a large increase in velocity (kinetic energy) at the impeller outlet.

steps.label: 4. Diffuser: velocity becomes pressure
steps.description: Fixed diffuser vanes around the impeller form widening channels. As the liquid slows down, much of its kinetic energy is converted into static pressure. Diffusers surround the whole impeller, which also keeps the radial hydraulic load low.

steps.label: 5. Return channel leads to the next impeller
steps.description: Behind the diffuser the flow turns through 180 degrees around the diaphragm and the return vanes guide it inward, removing most of the swirl, to the eye of the second impeller.

steps.label: 6. Pressure rises stage by stage
steps.description: Every stage adds roughly the same head, so the total head is about the number of stages times the head per stage (H_total ~ n x H_stage). The flow rate is the same through every stage. That is why multistage pumps are used for high heads at moderate flows: one impeller would need a very large diameter or speed to reach the same head.

steps.label: 7. Exit through the discharge nozzle
steps.description: The last-stage diffuser delivers the liquid into the discharge casing, which collects it and leads it to the discharge nozzle at the full pump pressure.

steps.label: 8. Balancing the axial thrust
steps.description: All impellers face the same way, so their axial forces add up toward the suction end. Behind the last impeller a balance drum (or disc) has discharge pressure on one side and the balance chamber, connected to suction by the leak-off line, on the other. The resulting force opposes the impeller thrust. A small leak-off flow (green) returns to suction.

sequences.label: Dismantling (3 stages)
sequences.caveat: Generic teaching sequence for a ring-section pump. Actual procedures, clearances, fits, tightening torques and special tools come from the OEM manual. Isolate and make safe under the site permit system.

steps.label: Isolate, drain and make safe
steps.description: Lock out and tag out the motor, close and secure the suction and discharge valves, relieve pressure, drain and vent the casing (and the balance line), and let the pump cool. Disconnect auxiliary piping. Follow the site permit system and the OEM manual.

steps.label: Remove the coupling guard and spacer
steps.description: Take off the guard, unbolt and remove the coupling spacer and flexible elements. Record the as-found alignment before disturbing anything.

steps.label: Remove the non-drive-end bearing
steps.description: Drain the bearing oil, remove the end cover, release the bearing locknut and pull the bearing housing and bearing off the shaft end with a suitable puller. Note the orientation of paired angular-contact bearings (drum design).

steps.label: Remove the NDE shaft nut, mechanical seal and seal chamber
steps.description: Set the seal setting clips or record the setting dimension, remove the shaft nut, then withdraw the seal (cartridge or components), the shaft sleeve and the seal chamber. Protect the seal faces.

steps.label: Remove the discharge cover and the balance device
steps.description: Unbolt the discharge cover. Withdraw the balance drum (or disc) from the shaft and inspect the running surfaces and the drum bush (or disc seat). Measure the clearance or axial gap before cleaning, and compare with the OEM limits.

steps.label: Remove the tie bolts
steps.description: Support the casing sections, mark them so that they go back in the same order and orientation, then slacken the tie-bolt nuts gradually in a crossing pattern and withdraw the tie bolts.

steps.label: Remove the discharge casing (with the last-stage diffuser)
steps.description: Slide the discharge casing off along the shaft axis, keeping it square so that it does not drag on the rotor. The last-stage diffuser comes out with it. Discard the joint gasket or O-ring.

steps.label: Remove the stage 3 impeller and stage casing 2
steps.description: Pull the impeller off the shaft (a puller may be needed if it is a shrink or tight fit) and remove its key. Keep each impeller with its own stage parts and mark the stage number. Then slide off stage casing 2 together with its diffuser, return channel, interstage bush and the stage 3 wear ring, and the interstage sleeve behind impeller 2.

steps.label: Remove the stage 2 impeller and stage casing 1
steps.description: Pull the impeller off the shaft (a puller may be needed if it is a shrink or tight fit) and remove its key. Keep each impeller with its own stage parts and mark the stage number. Then slide off stage casing 1 together with its diffuser, return channel, interstage bush and the stage 2 wear ring, and the interstage sleeve behind impeller 1.

steps.label: Remove the first-stage impeller
steps.description: Pull the impeller off the shaft (a puller may be needed if it is a shrink or tight fit) and remove its key. Keep each impeller with its own stage parts and mark the stage number. The first-stage casing wear ring stays in the suction casing; inspect it in place.

steps.label: Remove the pump coupling hub, DE bearing and DE seal
steps.description: Pull the coupling hub, remove the DE bearing housing and bearing, then the DE shaft nut, seal, sleeve and seal chamber, as at the other end.

steps.label: Withdraw and inspect the shaft
steps.description: Withdraw the shaft toward the drive end. Check run-out between centres or V-blocks, the condition of the impeller seats, keyways, threads and bearing journals, and compare with the OEM limits.

steps.label: Parts cleaned, inspected and laid out
steps.description: All parts are clean and inspected, worn parts replaced, new gaskets and O-rings ready. Follow the OEM manual for clearances, fits and torques.

steps.label: Fit the shaft
steps.description: Check the shaft is clean, straight and undamaged; fit it into the suction casing from the drive end.

steps.label: Fit the pump coupling hub, DE bearing and DE seal
steps.description: Fit the DE seal chamber, sleeve, seal (setting dimension per the seal drawing), shaft nut, bearing and housing, and the coupling hub.

steps.label: Fit the first-stage impeller
steps.description: Fit the stage parts in the reverse order: stage casing with a new joint gasket, diffuser and return channel, interstage sleeve, then the impeller and key. Check that each impeller sits against its spacer and that the wear-ring clearance is within the OEM limits.

steps.label: Fit the stage 2 impeller and stage casing 1
steps.description: Fit the stage parts in the reverse order: stage casing with a new joint gasket, diffuser and return channel, interstage sleeve, then the impeller and key. Check that each impeller sits against its spacer and that the wear-ring clearance is within the OEM limits.

steps.label: Fit the stage 3 impeller and stage casing 2
steps.description: Fit the stage parts in the reverse order: stage casing with a new joint gasket, diffuser and return channel, interstage sleeve, then the impeller and key. Check that each impeller sits against its spacer and that the wear-ring clearance is within the OEM limits.

steps.label: Fit the discharge casing (with the last-stage diffuser)
steps.description: Fit a new joint gasket or O-ring and slide the discharge casing (with the last-stage diffuser) into place.

steps.label: Fit the tie bolts
steps.description: Fit the tie bolts and tighten the nuts in stages, in a crossing pattern, to the OEM torque or tension. Check that the casing feet still sit flat.

steps.label: Fit the discharge cover and the balance device
steps.description: Fit the balance drum (or disc) and its bush (or seat), then the discharge cover. Check the rotor axial position / float as the OEM manual describes.

steps.label: Fit the NDE shaft nut, mechanical seal and seal chamber
steps.description: Fit the NDE seal chamber, sleeve, seal and shaft nut. The impeller stack must be fully clamped; then release the seal setting clips.

steps.label: Fit the non-drive-end bearing
steps.description: Fit the NDE bearing (paired bearings in the correct orientation), locknut, housing and covers; fill with the specified oil.

steps.label: Fit the coupling guard and spacer
steps.description: Align the shafts (the final alignment check is with the piping connected), fit the spacer and elements, then the guard. Check free rotation by hand.

sequences.label: Reassembly (4 stages)
sequences.caveat: Generic teaching sequence. Use the OEM manual for clearances, fits, torques, rotor axial position and alignment tolerances.

steps.description: Align the shafts (the final alignment check is with the piping connected), fit the spacer and elements, then the guard. Check free rotation by hand.

sequences.label: Reassembly (6 stages)
sequences.caveat: Generic teaching sequence. Use the OEM manual for clearances, fits, torques, rotor axial position and alignment tolerances.

steps.label: Parts cleaned, inspected and laid out
steps.description: All parts are clean and inspected, worn parts replaced, new gaskets and O-rings ready. Follow the OEM manual for clearances, fits and torques.

steps.label: Fit the shaft
steps.description: Check the shaft is clean, straight and undamaged; fit it into the suction casing from the drive end.

steps.label: Fit the pump coupling hub, DE bearing and DE seal
steps.description: Fit the DE seal chamber, sleeve, seal (setting dimension per the seal drawing), shaft nut, bearing and housing, and the coupling hub.

steps.label: Fit the first-stage impeller
steps.description: Fit the stage parts in the reverse order: stage casing with a new joint gasket, diffuser and return channel, interstage sleeve, then the impeller and key. Check that each impeller sits against its spacer and that the wear-ring clearance is within the OEM limits.

steps.label: Fit the stage 2 impeller and stage casing 1
steps.description: Fit the stage parts in the reverse order: stage casing with a new joint gasket, diffuser and return channel, interstage sleeve, then the impeller and key. Check that each impeller sits against its spacer and that the wear-ring clearance is within the OEM limits.

steps.label: Fit the stage 3 impeller and stage casing 2
steps.description: Fit the stage parts in the reverse order: stage casing with a new joint gasket, diffuser and return channel, interstage sleeve, then the impeller and key. Check that each impeller sits against its spacer and that the wear-ring clearance is within the OEM limits.

steps.label: Fit the stage 4 impeller and stage casing 3
steps.description: Fit the stage parts in the reverse order: stage casing with a new joint gasket, diffuser and return channel, interstage sleeve, then the impeller and key. Check that each impeller sits against its spacer and that the wear-ring clearance is within the OEM limits.

steps.label: Fit the stage 5 impeller and stage casing 4
steps.description: Fit the stage parts in the reverse order: stage casing with a new joint gasket, diffuser and return channel, interstage sleeve, then the impeller and key. Check that each impeller sits against its spacer and that the wear-ring clearance is within the OEM limits.

steps.label: Fit the stage 6 impeller and stage casing 5
steps.description: Fit the stage parts in the reverse order: stage casing with a new joint gasket, diffuser and return channel, interstage sleeve, then the impeller and key. Check that each impeller sits against its spacer and that the wear-ring clearance is within the OEM limits.

steps.label: Fit the discharge casing (with the last-stage diffuser)
steps.description: Fit a new joint gasket or O-ring and slide the discharge casing (with the last-stage diffuser) into place.

steps.label: Fit the tie bolts
steps.description: Fit the tie bolts and tighten the nuts in stages, in a crossing pattern, to the OEM torque or tension. Check that the casing feet still sit flat.

steps.label: Fit the discharge cover and the balance device
steps.description: Fit the balance drum (or disc) and its bush (or seat), then the discharge cover. Check the rotor axial position / float as the OEM manual describes.

steps.label: Fit the NDE shaft nut, mechanical seal and seal chamber
steps.description: Fit the NDE seal chamber, sleeve, seal and shaft nut. The impeller stack must be fully clamped; then release the seal setting clips.

steps.label: Fit the non-drive-end bearing
steps.description: Fit the NDE bearing (paired bearings in the correct orientation), locknut, housing and covers; fill with the specified oil.

steps.label: Fit the coupling guard and spacer
steps.description: Align the shafts (the final alignment check is with the piping connected), fit the spacer and elements, then the guard. Check free rotation by hand.
